system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Context-aware discovery keeps the
Agent prompt concise while the complete Skill catalog remains available to
browse and manage.
system_prompt_style.note: README prose; project instructions from AGENTS.md/DEEPCODE.md, Skills and memory are combined into context. No prompt-assembly code in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
DeepCode can read and search code, edit files, apply patches, run commands and
tests, and continue working from the results.
env_context_strategy.note: Paper-era Paper2Code pipeline used CodeRAG retrieval; v2 default is tool-driven.

context_compaction.evidence_quote:
Project rules,
persistent memory, Skills, and long-conversation compaction help the Agent keep
context throughout complex work.
context_compaction.note: Mechanism of compaction not visible in evidence; summarize assumed from 'compaction'. Paper CodeMem summarizes files.

observation_format.note: Observation conversion code not in truncated evidence.

tool_call_format.note: Parser code not in evidence; README mentions 'native file and shell tools' only.

edit_primitive.note: README says 'edit files, apply patches' but edit tool schema not in evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote:
share one generic
stdio/SSE/Streamable HTTP client runtime with bounded discovery, stable tool
identities
tool_schema_source.note: Only MCP source visible; native tool schema source not in evidence.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Connect standard MCP servers from every interface.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
The Agent keeps analyzing, implementing, verifying, and fixing
around that Goal without requiring you to push every step manually.
loop_primitives.note: event_log authoritative event stream (docs/AUTOMATION_ARCHITECTURE.md). Paper2Code workflow is a fixed_pipeline in paper.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: `ThreadGoal` | What outcome is the agent still pursuing across Turns?
planning_granularity.note: Durable Goal object persisted across Turns.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
Complex work can be split across focused Agents—for example, separate Agents
for code investigation, test analysis, and implementation review.
multi_agent_topology.note: Default appears single agent; orchestrator_workers reachable via delegation. Paper describes multi-agent pipeline.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
focused
work can be delegated in isolated worktrees with explicit conflict handling.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: **Ask**: confirm sensitive operations before they run;
human_in_loop.note: Three modes Ask/Read only/Full access; per-tool allow/ask/deny. Automation defaults to safe default mode.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
A Session stores more than chat text: it keeps tool calls, permission
decisions, Goals, model configuration, and verification records.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote:
project instructions can live in `AGENTS.md` or `DEEPCODE.md`, and
  persistent notes remain with the workspace.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
Long-running Goals
  are resumable across CLI and Desktop

self_verification.evidence_quote:
A failed verification is not presented as success. It becomes input to the
next repair.
self_verification.note: Unclear whether harness or model runs tests. Paper describes static analysis agent and sandbox execution.

retry_policy.note: Docs state no fixed number of retries hardcoded; task retry policy not visible.

termination_condition.note: Run loop not in evidence; docs state it does not hardcode a fixed number of agent iterations.

timeouts.evidence_quote:
bounded discovery, stable tool
identities, timeouts, cancellation, and session-owned cleanup.
timeouts.note: Timeouts mentioned for MCP runtime only.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
A Job Object backend gives the
  sandbox real process-tree isolation where previously there was none.
execution_isolation.note: Local platform sandboxing on host; worktree isolation for parallel agents.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: three-valued permissions, sensitive-path protection, platform sandboxing

permission_model.note: Default mode unclear; per_call_prompt in Ask mode.

replayability.evidence_quote:
Replay remains available after overflow, disconnection, or
restart.
replayability.note: Event replay for display; side effects not replayed.

eval_hooks.note: Paper evaluates PaperBench; runner location not visible.

open_source.note: From commented badge; LICENSE file not in evidence.
